verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships some built-in automatic triggers (automatic PR reviews on GitHub push events, agents polling for approved tasks, CLI runnable via cron) but there is no evidence of a general-purpose rule engine where an AI-native user can define custom event→action rules. Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger builder, support for arbitrary event types beyond PR/task polling, and user-configurable conditions rather than fixed built-in automations.
